floor_history.headline: Recon: floor 8 confirmed; 8 diffs are TWO independent reg-alloc/scheduling ties (inner sum/j $a0 swap; 2nd-loop LICM-const vs move preheader order) — both pure-C, greg-characterized, frontier built.
Region A quantified as a pure sum/j $a0<->$a1 swap (all surroundings match target); naive structural levers KILLED, pointing to the directed permuter.

Region A range-mechanism CONFIRMED: offset+=j flips the sum/j a0/a1 swap (score 7) but is not match-viable; zero-cost manual flips killed, so the flip needs the directed permuter's whole-function LUID
Directed permuter (real full-TU basin) found do-while(0) on sum=0 that solves Region A and lowers the honest floor 8->6; Region B has no clean permuter lever (all sub-130 finds invalid).
Fresh-seed floor-6 permuter (20.9k iters) + exhaustive preheader lineswap reconfirm no clean lever: Region A' tie unreachable by statement reorder, Region B yields only dead-alias cheats.

Forensics: both floor-6 residuals named to one GCC decision each (A'=sched.c rank_for_schedule INSN_LUID tiebreak coupled to the do-while(0) def-relocation; B=loop.c move_movables emit_insn_before(loo

frontier.hypothesis: A whole-function context change raises pseudo-77 (sum) global.c allocno priority above pseudo-79 (j) with sum's def kept at LOW LUID (so sched1 emits sum=0 first == target), decoupling the RA win from the scheduling loss.
frontier.mechanism: global.c allocno_compare priority = floor_log2(n_refs)*n_refs*size/live_length*10000. Target has sum=a0 with sum=0 emitted first (long preheader def span) and the SAME isolated inner range as build, so target's sum>j must come from whole-function live_length/allocno-numbering, not a late def. The do-while(0) only achieves sum>j via a late def, which loses A'.
frontier.next_probe: Directed permuter on the floor-6 full-TU basin restricted to whole-function structure OUTSIDE the preheader (e.g. the outer-loop tail / CopyBlock region) that shifts absolute LUIDs so pseudo-77's live_length drops below pseudo-79's without moving sum=0's def; vet every closing form against the constant-holder/dead-alias/offset+=j cheat catalog. s4/s5 fresh-seed campaigns found no clean sub-6 form, so bias new seeds toward structural (non-preheader) mutations.

frontier.hypothesis: Region B closes only if the two LICM invariants get LOWER LUID than the ap/a2p moves without a pre-loop reference (constant-holder cheat).
frontier.mechanism: loop.c move_movables emit_insn_before(loop_start) hard-codes the hoist point at preheader END. The invariants are referenced only inside the k-loop, so LICM controls placement; no source form referencing them only in-loop can lower their LUID below the moves.
frontier.next_probe: Design a k-loop shape where the range-test bound is part of a genuinely loop-carried computation with a real dependency chain to the pointer moves (raising the moves' LUID above the constants) rather than a bare literal pair; vet against constant-holder/dead-alias before proposing. Prior attempts (regionB-* family) all invalid/cheat.
